args.title: Re-enable the export button after a failed export
args.body:
File: src/api/reports.ts

In the export route (GET /reports/:id/export), if an export fails (for example, if the report has more than MAX_EXPORT_ROWS rows), the response does not indicate that the export cannot be retried without reloading the page. The Export button should be re-enabled after an error occurs, but it stays greyed out.
